column1: #source: computed directly (2026-09-13) from four self-mapping SSSOM files in https://github.com/LasseMempel/thesaurusscience (CC BY 4.0) - files where subject_source == object_source, so a missing inverse would have to appear as a separate row in the SAME file if it existed. Counted every row whose predicate is one of the three SKOS-symmetric properties (skos:exactMatch, skos:closeMatch, skos:relatedMatch - all three defined as symmetric in the SKOS Reference), and checked whether the reverse (object, predicate, subject) triple also appears in that file.
#comment: this is real, corpus-wide evidence for the scope of the gap scenario-01's amt:InverseAxiom closes - not just the two rows used in the main example.
